revisions.body: A developer has applied to build 39 homes on the site of a closed supermarket on Cotton Street. Plans can be seen at Millbrook Library and online; comments close on Tuesday 12 January 2027.

revisions.headline: Planning application: 25 homes on Juniper Street

revisions.headline: Residents react: Planning application: 39 homes on Cotton Street
revisions.body: A developer has applied to build 39 homes on the site of a closed supermarket on Cotton Street. Plans can be seen at Millbrook Library and online; comments close on Tuesday 12 January 2027. It is the second such change this year.

revisions.headline: Kestrel Coffee to close after 27 years
revisions.body: Kestrel Coffee on Net Lane will close at the end of January. The owner, Joy Okafor, said the rent had doubled.

revisions.headline: Overnight lane closure on Pinecrest Avenue
revisions.body: One lane of Pinecrest Avenue will be closed between 21:00 and 05:00 from Thursday 31 December to Friday 1 January 2027 for drain repairs. Buses keep their stops.

revisions.headline: Overnight lane closure on Riverside Drive
revisions.body: One lane of Riverside Drive will be closed between 21:00 and 05:00 from Thursday 31 December to Friday 1 January 2027 for a gas main inspection. Expect short delays.

revisions.headline: Wharf Street Primary chess club takes city title
revisions.body: Pupils from Wharf Street Primary were congratulated by the mayor this week. Their teacher said the group had practised after school since October.

revisions.headline: School board debates a new lunch provider
revisions.body: The Halden school board discussed a new lunch provider at its meeting this week. A decision is expected on Monday 8 February 2027. Two board members asked for more time.
